title: MetaDir: Local Directory Metadata for macOS
description:
MetaDir is a Swift-first macOS application and command-line tool for displaying, creating, editing, and validating structured directory metadata stored in local .metadir.yml files.

The application provides Finder Sync and Finder Quick Action integration. It operates locally, does not recursively scan directory contents, does not access the internet, and treats metadata links as copy-only.

MetaDir was developed with assistance from OpenAI/ChatGPT Model 5.6 Sol.
